documents.title: Artificial Intelligence (AI)
documents.stance_why: The page sets general guidelines (verify output, document use, guard data) but says 'Different fields, courses, and instructors will have different policies' and tells faculty to 'be clear about expectations', so the decision on student AI use is handed to instructors.
documents.summary: The Provost page gives general responsibilities for generative AI (accuracy, disclosure, data privacy, phishing, procurement) and defines key terms. It leaves student-use rules to instructors, with a faculty and staff FAQ and a student FAQ stressing asking and citing.

units.why: The opening says AI 'has the potential to facilitate research, revolutionize teaching', which names benefits without a rule, so it is a benefits statement (P87) rather than P44 (career skill).
units.anchor: Generative AI has the potential to facilitate research, revolutionize teaching

units.why: The passage lists open questions ('What impact will generative AI have on our ability to measure student learning') that frame why the university is issuing guidance; nearest is the institutional preamble P56, but it lists unanswered questions, not principles.
units.anchor: What impact will generative AI have on our ability to measure student learning
units.policy: The university frames its guidance around open questions about measuring student learning and research integrity.
units.fit_note: States open questions the university has not answered rather than purpose, scope or principles.

units.why: 'Content created by generative AI tools can include factual errors... It is your responsibility to ensure the accuracy' tells users to verify AI output, which is P31.
units.anchor: It is your responsibility to ensure the accuracy of what is reported in your work

units.why: The same passage tells users to review output for 'violations of copyright protections, and plagiarism'; this is the unintentional-plagiarism warning P120, since P31 is about factual accuracy.
units.anchor: Review all material produced for accuracy, violations of copyright protections, and plagiarism

units.why: 'Document and be transparent about all uses of Generative AI' requires disclosure of AI use, P24.
